campaign_brief.objective: Drive awareness and sales for the Radboards Classic 6.5 Inch Hoverboard, highlighting its ease of use, portability, and fun features for campus and short urban commutes.
campaign_brief.key_message: The Classic 6.5 Hoverboard makes getting around campus fun, fast, and easy, with auto-balancing, built-in Bluetooth speakers, and a dependable 8-10 km range.

proof_points.claim: Easy One Step Mounting with auto-balancing for beginners and skilled riders.
Built-in Bluetooth speakers for enjoying favourite tunes on the go.
Covers 8–10 km per charge with a top speed of 15 km/h.
Weighs just 7-8kg, making it easy to carry up stairs or between classes.
Handles 15-degree slopes with ease thanks to dual 250W motors.

campaign_brief.success_metric: Increase in product page visits and direct sales conversions for the Classic 6.5 Inch Hoverboard.

script.title: Your Campus Ride: The Radboards Classic 6.5

beats.line: Campus is huge. Walking between classes takes time.
Tired legs? Wish you could glide there faster?
It's easy to ride. Auto-balancing makes one-step mounting simple.
Play your music on built-in Bluetooth speakers. Ride to your own beat.
Go 8 to 10 km per charge. Top speeds up to 15 km/h.
Handles 15-degree slopes. Weighs just 7 to 8 kg.
Make campus commutes fun. Find your Classic 6.5 at Radboards.in.
